SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.quantity, o.commission, o.commission_rate, o.commission_status, o.order_time, o.submit_time, o.order_type, o.status, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.price, o.series_id, o.balance_after_order, o.frozen_balance_after_order,
COALESCE(g.id, h.id) AS goods_id, COALESCE(g.name, h.name) AS name, COALESCE(g.cover_url, h.cover_url) AS cover_url, COALESCE(g.description, h.description) AS description, COALESCE(g.status, h.status) AS goods_status, COALESCE(g.create_time, h.create_time) AS goods_create_time, COALESCE(g.update_time, h.update_time) AS goods_update_time,
g.id AS goods_id, g.name AS name, g.cover_url AS cover_url, g.description AS description, g.status AS goods_status, g.create_time AS goods_create_time, g.update_time AS goods_update_time,
u.username,u.phone,u.deal_count
FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN order_goods g ON o.product_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN order_goods_hotel h ON o.product_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN order_member_user u on u.id = o.user_id

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.quantity, o.commission, o.commission_rate, o.commission_status, o.order_time, o.submit_time, o.order_type, o.status, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.price, o.series_id, o.balance_after_order, o.frozen_balance_after_order,
-- 默认只取 order_goods 的商品列 g.id AS goods_id, g.name AS name, g.cover_url AS cover_url, g.description AS description, g.status AS goods_status, g.create_time AS goods_create_time, g.update_time AS goods_update_time,
u.username,u.phone,u.deal_count
FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN order_goods g ON o.product_id = g.id LEFT JOIN order_goods_hotel h ON o.product_id = h.id LEFT JOIN order_member_user u on u.id = o.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM order_info o WHERE o.status != 0 AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE o.status = 1 AND o.order_type = 1 AND o.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.commission, o.order_type, o.status, o.create_time, o.price, o.balance_after_order, o.frozen_balance_after_order,
COALESCE(g.name, h.name) AS name, COALESCE(g.cover_url, h.cover_url) AS cover_url
g.name AS name, g.cover_url AS cover_url
FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN order_goods g ON o.product_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN order_goods_hotel h ON o.product_id = h.id
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}
AND o.status IN (1, 2)
AND o.status = #{status}
order by o.create_time desc
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_info WHERE status = 1
